title: docs(skills): the formula skill teaches that a date field is its ISO text and goes through date() before a timestamp-only call

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DUStsVcS1JXscUqQz41xB4T)_

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`objectstack-formula` 技能的「Dates」一节新增一段四行提示:日期、日期时间字段在表达式里是它的 ISO 文本;直接交给只收时间戳的函数或方法,构建会拒绝(`date-text-call`);先用 `date()` 包一层,写成 `isoDate(date(record.start_at))`、`date(record.start_date).getFullYear()`;和文本拼接、和文本字面量比较则直接用文本。另加一条评测题,期望答案是 `isoDate(date(record.start_at))`。
- **为什么改**:18.4.0 起(PR #32817)编写期会拒绝 `isoDate(record.start_at)` 这类写法。技能原先只在表格里有一句「Text in? `isoDate(date(s))`」,没说日期字段本身就是文本,客户的 agent 照旧写法会直接撞上拒绝。
- **风险与回滚**:只改技能文案、一条评测和一个 changeset,不动代码。同文件删掉 5 处别处已有的重复内容来付账:token 5971 → 5948(上限 5997 没动),行数 493 → 493。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看**:`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` 第 165 至 168 行(新增提示);第 222 行(删掉的重复开头句,最大的一处删减);`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` 第 10 题。
- **两分钟验证**:运行 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,应看到 `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md 5948 / 5997 (-49)`。
- **需要你做的**:批准这个 Tier H PR(`skills/**` 需受管审批人批准),之后席位落地。

## What changes

**One new note** in `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, § ObjectStack CEL standard library, **Dates**, directly under the function table (L165-168):

> **A `date` / `datetime` field is its ISO text.** The build refuses it in a timestamp-only call or method (`date-text-call`); wrap it in `date()` first: `isoDate(date(record.start_at))`, `date(record.start_date).getFullYear()`. `+` with text and ordering against a text literal take the text as is.

The skill has no list of refusal words, so `date-text-call` is named inside the note, where an author who meets the refusal will search for it.

**Five cuts in the same file** pay for it. Each row names the cut text and where its content still lives:

| # | Where | Cut | Its content still lives in |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | L163, `isoDate(t)` / `isoDatetime(t)` row | "Text in? `isoDate(date(s))`" | the new note two lines below, which gives the same wrap on a real field |
| 2 | Dates "Want / Write" table | the "Span in days: `daysBetween(start, end)`" row | the note above that table ("Use `daysBetween(a, b)`") and the `daysBetween(a, b)` row of the function table |
| 3 | L222, the note under the built-ins | "The list above is `CEL_STDLIB_FUNCTIONS`, the bare-callable public subset: the names you may write as `fn(x)`." | the section's opening paragraph (L148-149): "Its exported `CEL_STDLIB_FUNCTIONS` is the advertised bare-callable subset … this table documents them all" |
| 4 | L310, Mandatory pattern 4 | "The stdlib helpers honour the pinned `now` from `EvalContext`, so they are safe inside one." | the `now()` row (L155): "Pinned per evaluation run; deterministic in build" |
| 5 | L352, Mandatory pattern 5, second example | the two-line code comment "Fires once per row that ACTUALLY transitioned, on `update(id)` and on `update({multi: true})` alike." | the sentence right above the block (L348-350): "it means the same thing whether the write carries an id or a predicate"; and the paragraph below it: "evaluated **per row**" |

No line was re-wrapped to buy room: cuts 2, 4 and 5 remove whole lines, cut 3 removes one whole line and the head of the next, cut 1 shortens one table cell.

**One new eval**, id 10 in `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json`: a `start_day` formula over the `start_at` datetime field. `must_contain` is `isoDate(date(record.start_at))` and the `F` tag; `must_not_contain` is the bare `isoDate(record.start_at)` and a brace-wrapped field.

`.changeset/32818-formula-skill-date-wrap.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

## Tests

Skill prose, one eval fixture and one changeset. No package code changes, so no test is added and no ablation applies.

What the note teaches was measured against main's built `@objectstack/formula` (`validateExpression('value', …)` on an object with a `date` field `start_date` and a `datetime` field `start_at`, then `celEngine.evaluate` on the text row a read door serves):

<details><summary>Probe output</summary>

```text
isoDate(record.start_at)               => date-text-call | eval: found no matching overload for 'isoDate(string)'
record.start_date.getFullYear()        => date-text-call | eval: found no matching overload for 'string.getFullYear()'
isoDate(date(record.start_at))         => clean | eval "2026-11-16"
date(record.start_date).getFullYear()  => clean | eval 2026
isoDatetime(date(record.start_at))     => clean | eval "2026-11-16T09:30:00.000Z"
record.title + " " + record.start_at   => clean | eval "Kickoff 2026-11-16T09:30:00.000Z"
record.start_date < "2026-12-01"       => clean | eval true
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's three asks are all met: the Dates note, the refusal word (named in the note, since the skill has no refusal list), and one eval that expects `isoDate(date(record.start_at))`.
- The note says "The build refuses", the file's existing spelling for an authoring-gate refusal (the "No date arithmetic" note right below uses the same words). The refusal's site-specific arms (`date-text-call-fail-closed` and the others) are not listed: they share the `date-text-call` stem an author will search for.
